name: Swiss chard

schedule.notes: Soak seed clusters 8 hours; thin to one plant.
Pick outer stalks at the base; plant keeps producing through frost.

harvest.cues: Outer leaves are 8 to 12 in. Cut at the base 1 in above the soil; inner crown regenerates.
harvest.storageNotes: Wrap in damp paper towel, fridge 5 to 7 days. Stems and leaves can be cooked separately — stems take 2 to 3 extra minutes.

varieties.name: Bright Lights
varieties.notes: Mixed yellow/red/orange/pink stems. Striking, slightly less productive.

notes: One of the longest-producing greens — single planting can feed you from late spring through hard frost. More heat-tolerant than spinach.
